senses.gloss: <cite ref="A00769"><he>אוּנְקַל</he></cite>, <cite ref="N01220"><he>נִקְלָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00778"><he>נִיקְלַי</he></cite> f. (<he>נקל</he>, <he>קל</he>, cmp. esp.
units: II Sam. VI, 20 to 22) the light garment, whence, a name for the easy dress worn in the house and, under the cloak, in the street, but in which it was unbecoming to appear in public. [Cmp. II Sam. l. c. a.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite>; a. e.] <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 6:3:7">Y. Yoma VI, 43ᵈ</cite> top <cite ref="A00772"><he>אוּנְקְלָה</he></cite>, <he>נקלה</he>, for which <cite ref="Menachot 109b">Men. 109ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="A00775"><he>אונקלי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82a">Snh. 82ᵃ</cite> he took off the point of his spear <he>והניחה באונקלוֹ</he> (some ed. <cite ref="L00400"><he>לי</he></cite>—) and put it (hiding it) in his undergarment.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 24a:16">M. Kat. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>אָבֵל מטייל בא׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מטייל אָבֵל</he>) a mourner may walk on the Sabbath within the limits of his house (garden &c.) in the easy dress (showing the rent on account of a death in the family; Rashi).
<cite ref="Shabbat 120a:8">Sabb. 120ᵃ</cite> (garments to be saved from fire on a Sabbath) <cite ref="A00775"><he>אונקלי</he></cite>; Y. ib. XVI, 15ᵈ top <cite ref="N00778"><he>ניקלי</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:8">Meg. IV, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Megillah 24b:16">24ᵇ</cite>) <cite ref="A00172"><he>בית א׳</he></cite>; (read as) Y.

<cite ref="Megillah 24b:16">ib.</cite> a. Mss. <he>בית יד א׳</he> the sleeve of his under-dress. [<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 4:11">Tosef. Maas. Sh. IV, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="A00775">foreg.</cite> 2.]
